title: Count Me as One, with the Dirac Anchor Recovered: The Figure-Eight Knot, the Trefoil's Turn and One Trace Ladder, joined to APS Rulers, the Chiral Seed and a Signed Boundary Test
description:
Paper (PDF and TeX), Lean 4 proofs (280 theorems, 25 false controls, relations graph of 280 nodes and 238 edges, all checks passing on GitHub Actions), checks script, film and plates renderer, and the public article Tying the Knot, by Jeromie Beasley.

AI-assisted: the research direction, the questions and the three working rules are Jeromie Beasley's; Part I was written with Claude (Anthropic); Part II was assembled by Ink Between the Stars (a Grok bot), which prepared the statements of its Lean libraries; Lean Green PR Machine (a Grok bot) wrote those libraries (DiracTimeD25, CMaOBridge, D28); Part II was completed with Claude.
